tool_args.rationale: The pilot only covers H=0.16–0.48, while the forecast target is H=20.4. At short horizons, a slow exponential mainly reveals the amplitude-to-time-constant ratio, so models that fit the pilot can still disagree on whether the response reverses. Buy the long-horizon probe before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon law now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon rows may constrain the early response but do not reliably separate slow adaptation amplitude from its time constant or establish the sign at H=20.4.
It omits the observed sink-gradient signature and leaves the slow timescale unresolved.
Finer sampling offers less direct evidence about the long-horizon response than a probe designed to discriminate slow adaptation.
